name: AMD partner article: Introducing the AMD Radeon RX 7900 Series Graphics
notes: AMD first-party launch article, used ONLY because the per-SKU product page omits the memory interface width. It carries the spec table row verbatim: 'AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX | 96 | 24 GB | 2.3 | Up to 2.5 | 384-bit | 96 MB | 355W | $999' (columns: compute units, memory, game clock GHz, boost clock GHz, memory interface, Infinity Cache, TBP, SEP price), and separately 'up to 24GB of high-speed GDDR6 memory running at 20Gbps over a 384-bit memory bus' in AMD's own summary text. Also the on-shelf date: 'The first of the AMD Radeon RX 7900 Series graphics family will be available on-shelf and from your local distributor from December 13th.' Corroborates 355 W TBP against the product page. Footnote GD-151 on the same page is the source of the 5.3 TB/s Infinity-Cache-inclusive 'effective' bandwidth claim, which is why that number is NOT recorded as the DRAM figure. Accessed 2026-10-03. KIND NOTE: filed as 'blog' because the schema's kind enum has no 'press-release' member. It is AMD's own first-party launch article carrying AMD's own spec table, which is materially stronger than the ordinary meaning of 'blog'.
